275002137.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

As physical media sees a resurgence, these sealed tapes offer a reliable way to capture analog audio on cassette decks and portable recorders.
Items Included:

Cross
Model 3502 Lustrous Chrome Ballpoint Pens
Lot of 2
Original Boxes and Instructions Included
The Cross Century is a definitive classic of American industrial design, celebrated for its slim, elegant profile and legendary reliability. These model 3502 ballpoint pens feature the signature lustrous chrome finish with subtle incised line patterns that provide both visual texture and a secure grip. A staple of professional stationery since 1946, these pens utilize a smooth twist-action mechanism and represent the enduring quality of the Cross brand.
Set of two ballpoint pens with polished chrome appointments
Iconic slim silhouette with signature conical top
Personalized barrel engravings: "JIM" and "PHILLIP"
Includes original presentation boxes, sleeves, and guarantee documents
Model: 3502 Chrome, Made in USA
Condition:
Very good overall condition with average wear consistent with gentle use. The chrome finish remains bright with minor surface micro-scratching. Both pens are personalized with engraved names as noted. Mechanisms have been tested and are fully functional.
